groups.defect: The AccessTokenContext constructor null-checks grantType a second time instead of rawTokenId, so a null rawTokenId is never rejected.
groups.rationale: All four point at line 73's copy-paste requireNonNull(grantType, ...) and propose the same one-line fix.

groups.defect: isAccessTokenId reads the grant shortcut with substring(3,5) instead of substring(4,6) and inverts the equality check, so the grant assertion never checks anything; it also has no length guard, so a short prefix can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: All describe the same wrong offset and inverted condition in the same matcher. s_271c9373 also reports the StringIndexOutOfBounds risk, so the merged comment needs to keep that point.

groups.defect: The getShortcut() javadoc suggests 3-letter shortcuts, but the decoder requires a 6-char context (2-char grant shortcut) and nothing checks the length, so tokens from a conforming custom grant can't be decoded; also, colon-containing ids with a prefix that isn't 6 chars throw instead of falling back to UNKNOWN.
groups.rationale: All three report the same mismatch between the javadoc and the decoder's fixed length, one from the SPI javadoc and two from the decoder. s_07f54fcf adds the inconsistent fallback for non-6-char prefixes.
